item.title: MBARI researchers film chance encounter with a rare deep-sea bigfin squid
item.description: MBARI scientists encountered the rarely seen deep-sea bigfin squid (Magnapinna sp.).
item.content:encoded: The team was surveying the abyssal seafloor near Davidson Seamount with ROV Doc Ricketts, approximately 3,277 meters (10,751 feet) underwater, 35.720 N, 122.720 W.
